goal.text: Редактура текста сохраняет смысл: факты, условия и оговорки не теряются и не выдумываются
goal.reason: the audit showed the meaning-preservation examples and the skill manifest were outside the aim scope, so the aim could not be verified there

claims.text: golden fixtures classify as expected by benchmark-skill.sh
claims.falsifier: fixture expectations drift from script behavior

claims.text: all SKILL.md and prompts pass frontmatter and smoke validation
claims.falsifier: a skill loses its frontmatter or the manifest drifts

claims.text: benchmark reports non-zero vacuum-filling on the known RU AI fixture

requirements.spec: bash scripts/benchmark-skill.sh tests/fixtures/ru-ai-typical.txt --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(0 if d["metrics"]["V"]>0 else 1)'

claims.text: editing fixtures are structurally valid and gold edits preserve source numbers
claims.falsifier: a fixture loses required fields or a gold edit silently drops a fact

claims.text: the examples preserve the source facts: every number in an after block already exists in its before block
claims.falsifier: an after block introduces a number that the before block never contained
claims.control: sed -i 's/Простой в использовании, настраивается под процесс команды./Простой в использовании, настраивается под процесс команды. Обрабатывает 500 RPS./' knowledge/04-Examples/before-after.md

claims.text: every skill path declared in the manifest exists in the repository
claims.falsifier: a manifest declares a skill path that does not exist

claims.text: all shell scripts in scripts/ parse under bash -n

requirements.spec: bash -c 'for f in scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done'

claims.falsifier: a script gains a syntax error and nothing notices

claims.text: every Obsidian wikilink in the knowledge vault resolves to an existing file
claims.falsifier: a note is renamed or a link is added pointing nowhere
